name: Nestlé S.A.
auditedBridge: FY24 Organic +2.2% (RIG +1.4%, Pricing +0.8%); 5Y Reported Delta -1.22B CHF driven by net divestitures & FX (-14.2B CHF: divested Skin Health CHF 10.2B, US Water CHF 4.3B, Yinlu; acquired Bountiful $5.75B).
kantarTelemetry: Maggi: Global #4 FMCG brand (3.1B+ CRPs, 38.2% global penetration). Nescafé: Global #5 F&B brand (2.1B+ CRPs, 26.5% penetration).

name: PepsiCo, Inc.
auditedBridge: 5Y Net Revenue +$24.69B (+36.8%); driven by cumulative net pricing realization (+31% across 2021-2024) and International revenue scaling to $37.0B (40% of total sales, 10% 5Y core EBIT CAGR).
kantarTelemetry: Lay's: Global #3 FMCG brand (3.3B+ CRPs, 32.1% global penetration). Pepsi: Global #2 beverage brand (3.9B+ CRPs, 41.2% penetration).

name: Mondelēz International
auditedBridge: 5Y Net Revenue +$10.57B (+40.9%); driven by organic pricing to offset record 2023-2024 cocoa inflation plus bolt-on M&A: Clif Bar ($2.9B), Ricolino ($1.3B), Chipita ($2.0B), and Give & Go.
kantarTelemetry: Oreo: Global #12 FMCG brand (1.7B+ CRPs, 24.4% global penetration); biscuits volume/mix positive (+0.6% in FY24 despite chocolate pricing).

name: Danone S.A.
auditedBridge: 5Y Reported Revenue +2.09B EUR (+8.3%); FY24 LFL +4.3% (Volume/Mix +3.0%, Price +1.3%). Reported top-line tempered by Russia EDP deconsolidation and Horizon Organic/Wallaby divestiture.
kantarTelemetry: Activia & Mizone: Delivered +3.0% consolidated volume/mix growth across all 4 quarters of FY24; Specialized & Medical Nutrition high repeat rate.

name: The Kraft Heinz Co.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +$0.87B; divested Planters ($3.35B) and Natural Cheese ($3.2B) to reduce net leverage from 4.4x to 3.0x; FY24 Organic Net Sales -2.1% (Price +1.4%, Volume/Mix -3.5%).
kantarTelemetry: Heinz: Global Top 20 FMCG brand (1.4B+ CRPs, 28.0% global penetration); US retail volume pressured by SNAP reductions and private-label trade-down.

name: General Mills, Inc.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +$2.99B (+17.7%); driven by 'Accelerate' portfolio reshaping (divested European Yoplait & Helper/Suddenly Salad; acquired Tyson Pet Treats $1.2B) and $1B+ Holistic Margin Management (HMM) savings.
kantarTelemetry: North America Retail household penetration held at 89.2% across total portfolio; FY24 organic net sales -1% as shoppers reduced snacking frequency.

name: Associated British Foods (Grocery & Ingred.)
auditedBridge: 5Y Grocery & Ingredients Revenue +£1.58B (+31.7%; Group F&B incl. Sugar £9.4B); FY24 Grocery Adj. Operating Profit rose +17% to £511M driven by Twinings, Ovaltine, and US specialty brands (Mazola, Acetum).
kantarTelemetry: Twinings & Ovaltine: Distributed in 100+ markets; Ovaltine ranked Top 15 F&B brand in Thailand and Switzerland by Kantar CRPs.

name: Unilever PLC (Nutrition & Ice Cream)
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +2.40B EUR (+12.4%) despite divesting ekaterra Tea (€4.5B in 2022); FY24 Nutrition €13.4B (USG +2.9%, UOM 20.3%) and Ice Cream €8.3B (USG +3.7%, UOM 13.9%).
kantarTelemetry: Knorr: Global #9 FMCG brand (2.0B+ CRPs, 30.8% global penetration). Hellmann's: 8.2% 5Y organic CAGR via squeeze-format & flavor extensions.

name: The Campbell's Company
auditedBridge: 5Y Continuing Ops Revenue +$1.53B (+18.9%); completed Sovos Brands acquisition ($2.7B in March 2024) adding Rao's Homemade ($1B+ run-rate) and delivered $950M+ multi-year cost savings.
kantarTelemetry: Campbell's Condensed Soup & Goldfish: 75%+ US household pantry penetration; Rao's household penetration expanded +340 bps YoY in FY24.

name: Conagra Brands, Inc.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +$2.51B (+26.3%) reflecting full Pinnacle Foods integration ($10.9B deal); FY24 organic net sales -2.1% (Volume -1.9%, Price/Mix -0.2%) offset by +310 bps supply chain productivity.
kantarTelemetry: Birds Eye, Healthy Choice & Slim Jim: #1 US single-serve frozen meals market share; frozen trip frequency recovered in H2 FY24.

name: Meiji Holdings Co., Ltd.
auditedBridge: Japanese Revenue Recognition Standard adoption (FY2021) reduced reported top line optically; Food segment JPY 901.6B (FY24/25: JPY 942.8B, OI JPY 68.7B) driven by multi-wave dairy/chocolate price revisions.
kantarTelemetry: Meiji Bulgaria Yogurt & SAVAS Protein: #1 functional yogurt and #1 sports protein share in Japan (42%+ domestic market share).

name: Morinaga & Co., Ltd.
auditedBridge: US Business (Hi-Chew) surged >3x over 5 years to JPY 19.8B+ alongside domestic 'in Jelly' functional nutritional drink volume growth (+8.4% YoY); FY24/25 revenue reached JPY 228.5B.
kantarTelemetry: in Jelly & Hi-Chew: #1 energy jelly drink in Japan (over 35% market share); Hi-Chew US convenience store distribution reached 110,000+ doors.

name: CJ CheilJedang Corp.
auditedBridge: 5Y Consolidated Revenue +KRW 7,007B (+31.3%); Food Division grew +41.7% (from KRW 8,010B to KRW 11,353B) propelled by Schwan's Company US integration and Bibigo Global Strategic Products (GSP).
kantarTelemetry: Bibigo & Hetbahn: #1 US frozen mandu/dumpling market share (>48% share); Hetbahn instant cooked rice domestic share >67%.

name: Lotte Wellfood Co., Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Statutory Revenue +KRW 1,951B (+93.2%) driven by July 2022 merger of Lotte Confectionery and Lotte Food (~KRW 1.7T added) plus India subsidiaries (Havmor Ice Cream + Lotte India) growing +11.6% YoY.
kantarTelemetry: Pepero & Zero (Sugar-Free Line): Pepero global sales surpassed KRW 200B; Zero sugar-free confectionery/ice cream exceeded KRW 50B within 24 months.

name: Daesang Corporation
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +KRW 1,294B (+43.7%); driven by global Jongga Kimchi exports (reaching $94M+ across 60 countries, US factory operational in Los Angeles) and starch/lysine bio recovery in FY24.
kantarTelemetry: Jongga & Chungjungone: #1 packaged kimchi brand globally (accounting for >50% of total South Korean kimchi export volume).

name: Universal Robina Corp.
auditedBridge: 5Y Continuing Revenue +PHP 27.71B (+20.7%); divested Oceania (Griffin's/Snack Brands Australia) in 2019-2021 to recycle capital into Munchy's Malaysia acquisition (MYR 1.925B) and domestic BCF.
kantarTelemetry: Great Taste, C2 & Jack 'n Jill: Ranked in Kantar Philippines Top 10 Most Chosen F&B brands (reaching >92% of Filipino households annually).

name: San Miguel Food and Beverage
auditedBridge: 5Y Consolidated Revenue +PHP 90.11B (+29.0%); San Miguel Foods division grew +32.8% (from PHP 139.5B to PHP 185.2B) via prepared/packaged foods (Purefoods, Magnolia, Star) and mega-poultry plants.
kantarTelemetry: Magnolia & Purefoods: Purchased by >85% of urban Filipino households in Kantar Worldpanel Philippines tracking.

name: Fraser and Neave, Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +SGD 260M (+13.7%); Dairies segment contributed 58% of Group PBIT, supported by F&N Dairies Thailand canned milk share and 100% buyout of Cocoaland Holdings (Malaysia confectionery) in 2022.
kantarTelemetry: 100PLUS & F&N Magnolia/Teapot: #1 isotonic beverage in Malaysia & Singapore; #1 condensed/evaporated milk share in Thailand and Malaysia.

name: Nestlé (Malaysia) Berhad
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +MYR 700M (+12.7%); grew steadily to a peak of MYR 7.05B in FY2023 before experiencing a -11.7% domestic revenue contraction in FY2024 due to consumer boycotts and cocoa/coffee inflation.
kantarTelemetry: Milo & Maggi Malaysia: Historically #1 and #2 most penetrated FMCG brands in Kantar Malaysia (>88% household reach prior to 2024 sentiment headwinds).

name: Thai President Foods PCL
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +THB 4.91B (+20.0%); driven by high-margin MAMA OK premium oriental noodles (THB 15/pack vs THB 6/7 base), President Bakery (Farmhouse bread) expansion, and 2023-24 palm oil/wheat moderation.
kantarTelemetry: MAMA: #1 instant noodle brand in Thailand (~50% domestic market share) and Kantar Thailand Top 5 Most Chosen Food Brand.

name: PT Indofood CBP Sukses Makmur Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 30.30T (+71.6%); propelled by $2.99B Pinehill Company Ltd acquisition (Aug 2020, adding 20+ plants across Africa/Middle East/SE Europe) plus domestic noodle EBIT margin reaching 26.8%.
kantarTelemetry: Indomie: Global #8 and Indonesia #1 FMCG brand in Kantar Brand Footprint (2.2B+ global CRPs; 96%+ Indonesian household penetration, ~38x annual frequency).

name: PT Indofood Sukses Makmur Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 39.20T (+51.2%); driven by CBP division (+71.6%) and Bogasari flour milling (IDR 29.8T gross sales) passing through wheat cycles while Agribusiness CPO lifted consolidated EBIT margin by +680 bps.
kantarTelemetry: Indomie, Indomilk, Chitato & Bimoli: Combined portfolio reaches >98% of Indonesian households across General Trade warungs and minimarkets.

name: PT Mayora Indah Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 11.04T (+44.1%); FY24 top line surged +14.6% YoY on +12% physical volume growth, though FY24 Gross Margin compressed from 26.7% to 23.0% due to historic coffee bean and cocoa cost spikes.
kantarTelemetry: Roma, Beng-Beng, Kopiko & Energen: Roma and Kopiko rank in Kantar Indonesia Top 10 F&B brands (75%+ household penetration); export sales represent 44% of revenue across 100+ markets.

name: PT Cisarua Mountain Dairy Tbk (Cimory)
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue increased 6.5x (+IDR 7.64T); Dairy reached IDR 3.95T and Premium Consumer Foods (Kanzler single-serve sausages/nuggets) reached IDR 5.08T, expanding Gross Margin to 45.1%.
kantarTelemetry: Miss Cimory D2C & Modern Trade: 9,500+ female agents delivering directly to households generated 14% of FY24 net sales (IDR 1.26T); Kanzler Singles achieved >80% minimarket distribution.

name: PT Ultrajaya Milk Industry & Trading Co. Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 2.63T (+42.1%); Dairy segment contributed 77% of revenue and RTD Tea (Teh Kotak) 19%; commissioned new automated distribution center and dairy farm capacity in Bandung/Sumatra.
kantarTelemetry: Ultra Milk & Teh Kotak: Audited #1 liquid UHT milk share in Indonesia (34%+ market share) and #1 RTD tea in carton packaging (61.8% market share).

name: PT Garudafood Putra Putri Jaya Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 3.80T (+45.0%); propelled by Mulino (Prochiz cheddar cheese) acquisition in Oct 2020 and Hormel Foods JV alongside snack/biscuit distribution integration across GT channels.
kantarTelemetry: Garuda, Gery & Chocolatos: Chocolatos and Gery Saluut rank among Top 15 Indonesian wafer/biscuit brands by Kantar penetration; Prochiz holds #2 domestic cheddar cheese share.

name: PT Siantar Top Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 1.44T (+41.0%) while Operating Profit surged +132% to IDR 1.37T; driven by strict SKU rationalization in extruded snacks/crackers, multi-island plant proximity (Sidoarjo, Medan, Bekasi), and <3% A&P ratio.
kantarTelemetry: Twistko, Mie Gemez, Go Potato & Goriorio: High-frequency Rp 500-Rp 2,000 sachet/pack price points dominating traditional warung and school channels across Tier-2/3 Indonesia.

name: PT Nippon Indosari Corpindo Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 0.59T (+17.7%); exited loss-making Philippines JV in 2020 to focus on 14 domestic bakery plants (Banjarmasin, Pekanbaru added) plus Sari Choco chocolate milk and jam spreads, lowering return rates.
kantarTelemetry: Sari Roti: #1 mass-produced packaged bread brand in Indonesia (~90% mass-market modern trade share) distributed across 90,000+ MT and GT outlets.

name: PT Diamond Food Indonesia Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 2.76T (+40.3%); cold-chain logistics fleet (1,000+ refrigerated trucks) and 24+ distribution hubs enabled rapid B2B foodservice and B2C retail scale in refrigerated dairy (Diamond, Brookfarm) and meats.
kantarTelemetry: Diamond UHT, Fresh Milk & Ice Cream: Leading cold-chain dairy and foodservice supplier serving >50,000 Horeca, bakery, and modern retail customers nationwide.

name: PT FKS Food Sejahtera Tbk
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +IDR 0.41T (+27.2%) and EBIT Margin swung +850 bps (from -2.1% to +6.4%); post-2020 FKS Group equity injection and PKPU debt restructuring restored working capital for Taro, Mie Kremezz, and Bihunku.
kantarTelemetry: Taro Net & Bihunku: Taro remains Top 3 puffed snack brand awareness in Indonesia; Bihunku instant rice vermicelli expanded MT shelf facings by +28% since 2021.

name: Inner Mongolia Yili Industrial Group
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 25.56B (+28.3%); acquired Ausnutria Dairy (2022) driving infant formula & adult milk powder to #1 domestic share (+7.5% YoY in FY24 to RMB 29.7B), offsetting -8.2% FY24 liquid milk channel destocking.
kantarTelemetry: Yili: #1 Most Chosen Brand in Kantar China Brand Footprint for 9 consecutive years (1.34B+ CRPs; 92.4% Chinese urban household penetration, ~7.8x annual frequency).

name: China Mengniu Dairy Co. Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 9.64B (+12.2%) despite -10.1% FY24 revenue contraction; raw milk cost deflation lifted FY24 Gross Margin by +240 bps to 39.6% and OP margin +190 bps to 8.2%, while Bellamy's goodwill impairment hit statutory net profit (RMB 104.5M).
kantarTelemetry: Mengniu: #2 Most Chosen Brand in Kantar China Brand Footprint (1.12B+ CRPs; 89.1% urban household penetration); Deluxe (Telunsu) remains China's #1 premium UHT milk SKU.

name: Tingyi (Master Kong) Holding Corp.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 18.67B (+30.1%); Beverages scaled to RMB 51.62B (+1.3% YoY) and Instant Noodles reached RMB 28.41B; FY24 Gross Margin expanded +270 bps to 33.1% via palm oil/sugar easing and 500ml RTD tea price hike (from RMB 3 to RMB 3.5).
kantarTelemetry: Master Kong (Kangshifu): #3 Most Chosen Brand in Kantar China Brand Footprint (890M+ CRPs; 83.5% household penetration).

name: Uni-President China Holdings Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 8.31B (+37.7%; Parent 1216.TW reached TWD 657.64B, +7.98% CAGR); Beverage revenue hit RMB 19.24B (+8.2% YoY in FY24 led by Uni Iced Tea, Green Tea & Haizhiyan) and Food hit RMB 9.99B (Tang Daren & The King of Tomato).
kantarTelemetry: Uni-President: Top 8 Kantar China Brand Footprint brand (510M+ CRPs; 71.2% urban household penetration); #1 convenience retail/logistics ecosystem in Taiwan.

name: Want Want China Holdings Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 3.42B (+17.0%); Hot-Kid Milk dairy/beverages reached RMB 11.95B (50.8% of total revenue) alongside rice crackers/candies; emerging channels (bulk snack discount chains, vending, OEM) exceeded 10% of revenue.
kantarTelemetry: Want Want (Wangwang): #6 Most Chosen Brand in Kantar China Brand Footprint (560M+ CRPs; 68.4% household penetration).

name: Bright Dairy & Food Co., Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 1.72B (+7.6%); consolidated New Zealand subsidiary Synlait Milk (recapitalized in 2024) while defending East China/Shanghai fresh pasteurized milk and cold-chain yogurt (Momchilovtsi) share against national UHT discounting.
kantarTelemetry: Bright (Guangming): Top 12 Kantar China Brand Footprint brand (340M+ CRPs); #1 fresh pasteurized milk household penetration in East China/Yangtze River Delta.

name: Three Squirrels Inc.
auditedBridge: V-Shaped Channel Re-Engineering: Revenue fell from RMB 10.17B (2019) to RMB 7.11B (2023) due to Tmall traffic decay and store closures, then surged +49.3% YoY in FY24 to RMB 10.62B via 'High-End Cost-Performance' pricing and in-house nut factories.
kantarTelemetry: Douyin & Community Discount Pivot: Douyin FY24 sales reached RMB 2.2B+ (surpassing Tmall), driving a +40%+ YoY surge in unit order volume despite lower ASP per pack.

name: Weilong Delicious Global Holdings Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue +RMB 2.89B (+85.5%); Vegetable snack products (Konjac Shuang & Fengchi Kelp) surged +59% YoY in FY24 to surpass seasoned flour (Latiao) as the #1 revenue contributor, paired with bulk snack discount chain distribution.
kantarTelemetry: Weilong: #1 spicy snack brand in China (~65%+ penetration among Gen-Z/Millennial shoppers; distributed across 1,800+ offline distributors and all major bulk snack discount chains).

name: Bestore Co., Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue -RMB 0.66B (-8.6%); executed a historic -22% average price reduction (up to -45%) across 300+ core SKUs in Nov 2023-2024 to defend traffic against pure-play discount snack chains, compressing FY24 gross margin by -260 bps.
kantarTelemetry: Operates 3,200+ offline stores in Central/South China; VIP member base exceeds 130M users, though per-trip basket value contracted following the 2023-2024 ASP cut.

name: Vitasoy International Holdings Ltd.
auditedBridge: 5Y Revenue -HKD 1.31B (-17.4%) following the July 2021 Mainland China consumer boycott (Mainland revenue dropped from HKD 5.0B peak to HKD 3.3B); FY23/24 and H1 FY24/25 profitability recovering via Mainland trade-spend discipline and dominant HK operations.
kantarTelemetry: Vitasoy & Vita Lemon Tea: #1 plant-based soy milk and #1 RTD tea brand in Hong Kong (>85% HK household penetration).
